title: 【早く終わらせた人ほど、仕事が増えていないか】生産性の分配の違和感
social_title: 効率化の利益は誰に戻るのか
description: AIで作業時間を短縮しても、担当業務と期待値が増えるだけでは働く人の負担は減りません。生産性向上と仕事の密度の関係を考えます。
summary: 仕事が早く終わっても人が楽になるとは限りません。効率化で生まれた余裕が誰に戻るのかを問います。
title_en: Does Faster Work Just Mean More Work for the Same Person?
description_en: AI can accelerate tasks without easing workloads. Consider whether saved time becomes space to think or simply a higher volume of assignments.
summary_en: Speeding up tasks does not automatically reduce pressure. The missing question is who receives the benefits of productivity gains.
topic: AIによる作業効率化と仕事の密度
tension: 処理速度が上がるほど仕事量の期待値も上がり、働く人の余裕が増えない場合がある
question: 作業時間の削減分を、改善や学習に使えているでしょうか
practice: 処理件数だけでなく例外対応と疲労、休息や学習に使える時間を合わせて測ります
lens: 生産性は組織の成果だけでなく、働く人の持続可能性も含めて評価できます
topic_en: AI productivity and increasing work intensity
tension_en: faster completion may raise expectations and task volume without giving workers more breathing room
question_en: When time is saved, can people use some of it for learning, recovery and improvement?
practice_en: Measure exceptions, overload and time for improvement alongside throughput and cycle time.
lens_en: Productivity needs to account for sustainable work, not only output per hour.

sources.title: ILO: Evidence on GenAI and work organisation
World Economic Forum: Future of Jobs Report 2025
European Commission: AI skills and literacy
